facts.value: Reads fp->mv.ca.specialhi.vel.y and calls ftCo_8009BB64(gobj) if its pre-decrement value is <= 0, then unconditionally subtracts one through the cached Fighter pointer after the call returns. With no intervening slot changes, ordinary small positive integer N calls the successor on invocation N+1; positive fractional values ordinarily require ceil(value) decrement-only invocations. Zero and negative values call immediately. Under ordinary IEEE arithmetic, NaN and positive infinity do not expire, negative infinity satisfies the comparison, and sufficiently large finite values can round subtraction away. Compiled identity with entry cargokneebend.x8 and the post-transition write's effect on successor storage remain unresolved.

facts.value: Declared int arg1 is copied unchanged into fp->mv.co.cargokneebend.x4. The visible caller ftCo_8009BB1C forwards only a nonzero ftCo_JumpInput from ftCo_Jump_GetInput. That getter prioritizes left-stick tap input over newly pressed X/Y and otherwise returns no input. Entry itself does not reject zero or arbitrary integers. The parameter locator does not independently prove a compiled register ABI.

facts.value: Obtains Fighter from gobj->user_data, stores arg1 in cargokneebend.x4, clears cargokneebend.x0, and copies cargo_hold.x24_JUMP_STARTUP_LAG into cargokneebend.x8. Requests motion x4_motion_state + 5 with Ft_MF_None and arguments 0, 1, 0, NULL, sets carrier animation rate to zero, and requests ftCo_MS_ShoulderedWait for victim_gobj. The victim updater leaves an already-ShoulderedWait victim unchanged; otherwise it changes motion with an optional freeze flag, runs common helpers, and installs an accessory callback. Carrier, attributes, and victim pointers are unchecked preconditions. No allocation or ownership transfer is present. Compiled identity with the animation expression and common kneebend fields is unresolved.
